title: APC Plotting To Set Nigeria On Hearth With Court Judgment
text:
The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has accused the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) of plotting to plunge Nigeria into disaster by means of what it described as a determined try and cripple the opposition following a Federal Excessive Court judgment invalidating the management of Senator David Mark and the candidacy of former Vice President Atiku Abubakar.
The get together stated the judgment delivered by Justice Peter Lifu of the Federal Excessive Court, Abuja, was politically motivated, alleging that its timing, barely 24 hours after the huge turnout at its presidential marketing campaign rally in Sokoto, uncovered the ruling get together’s rising panic over the rising reputation of the opposition.
In a press release on Thursday, ADC Nationwide Publicity Secretary, Mallam Bolaji Abdullahi, stated the judgment was an try and deny Nigerians the appropriate to freely select their leaders within the 2027 basic elections.
“We have now causes to consider that the judgment had lengthy been written on this case. The Sokoto rally was merely a set off that stampeded its supply,” Abdullahi stated.
He alleged that the ruling was designed to erase the get together and its candidates from the electoral contest regardless of what he described as overwhelming public assist for its political platform.
The ADC warned that the results of the judgment prolonged past Mark and Atiku, arguing that it may jeopardise the candidacies of 1000’s of its members contesting elections on the native, state and federal ranges.
“This isn’t about Atiku Abubakar or David Mark. It’s in regards to the democratic rights of Nigerians to freely select their very own leaders. It’s in regards to the rights of 1000’s of candidates to take part in a democratic course of,” the get together stated.
Difficult the authorized basis of the judgment, the ADC cited an earlier ruling by Justice Musa Liman of the identical Federal Excessive Court, delivered on July 2, 2026, in Go well with No. FHC/ABJ/CS/1637/2025, which affirmed the legitimacy of the Mark-led National Working Committee and directed the Unbiased Nationwide Electoral Commission (INEC) to recognise the management.

The get together, nonetheless, stated it was awaiting the Licensed True Copy of Justice Lifu’s judgment to ascertain its exact phrases and consequential orders.
The opposition get together vowed to problem the ruling by means of each obtainable judicial course of, whereas accusing the APC of repeatedly deploying courtroom instances to weaken political opponents every time the opposition gained momentum.
Warning in opposition to what it described as the damaging manipulation of the judiciary to get rid of political competitors, the ADC stated: “We warn the APC: don’t play with fires you can’t management. The peace and stability of Nigeria are larger than the ambition of any president or political get together.”
It challenged President Bola Tinubu and the APC to submit themselves to a free and truthful electoral contest in the event that they had been assured of their efficiency and recognition, insisting that the presidency was not an inheritance.
The get together additionally referred to as on the judiciary to not permit itself for use to impose dictatorship on the nation, urging its members nationwide to stay calm and law-abiding whereas it pursues authorized cures.
